iconicAnchor.label: IEEE standard graphic symbols for logic functions
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The standard treats graphic symbols as an international language for understanding functional behavior, connections, dependencies, and complex logic without needing physical-device detail.

sources.title: IEEE Standard Graphic Symbols for Logic Functions
supports: Standard symbols communicate logic behavior, inputs, outputs, connections, dependencies, combinational and sequential elements, and complex functions.

sources.title: Recommended Practice for Representation of Schematic Symbols in STEP AP 210
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
supports: A schematic symbol is a drafting representation of a functional element for human visualization, interpretation, and manipulation.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches standardized symbol, connected net, component id, functional block, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/circuit-schematic/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
